mentions.name: Disco
mentions.description: An open source project that lets users run their own PaaS (platform-as-a-service); in development for a few years, with the dqlite Python bindings set to become a structural, load-bearing component.
mentions.source_excerpt: this will soon be a structural ("load-bearing"! haha!) part of Disco, a project we've been working on for a few years which lets you run your own PaaS. we're growing and get nice love letters [5] which for an open source project is obviously deeply rewarding
mentions.author: gregsadetsky
